Alex Chen: Quick scrub — noticed tokens/sec drops when selector picks paged-attn for sequences > 1024. Profiling attached below, ran on an A100 prod shard.

Alex Chen: profile snippet:
```
-- worker 3 -- model:gpt-3x
kernel=flash_attn_v2    seq=512  batch=8  tokens/sec=22.4k  GPU%: 72  mem=22G
kernel=paged_attn      seq=2048 batch=4  tokens/sec=9.8k   GPU%: 60  mem=20G
kernel=fused_attn      seq=1024 batch=6  tokens/sec=18.1k  GPU%: 68  mem=21G
```

Alex Chen: naive $/M tokens calc (A100 @ $2.8/hr for this prod pool):
- flash: 22.4k tok/s -> ~80.64M tok/hr -> $2.8 / 80.64 ~= $0.0347 /M
- paged: 9.8k tok/s -> ~35.28M tok/hr -> $2.8 / 35.28 ~= $0.0794 /M

Priya Nair: :eyes: That 2.3x hit is big. Any chance selector heuristic is using worst-case p95 latency from samples with cold KV? We had an issue where p95 overrides for seq>1500.

Priya Nair: Can you paste the kernel selection debug log? should show why paged was chosen.

Alex Chen: dumping selector log:
```
[selector] seq=2048 p50_flash=45ms p95_flash=120ms p50_paged=40ms p95_paged=160ms -> choose=paged
[reason] policy=latency_p95_threshold threshold=150ms
kv_cache_hit_ratio=0.87
```

Marco Silva: hmm kv_cache_hit_ratio 0.87 isn't terrible but eviction spikes might cause p95 tail. We saw backfill recompute for sessions when LLAMA cache invalidation triggers.

Lina Gomez: Try forcing kernel override for a sample shard: set REDWOOD_KERNEL_ORDER=flash,flash_attn_v2,fused,paged and run bench. Also tweak batching heuristic: prefer batch growth up to 16 for flash.

Lina Gomez: run:
```
./tools/bench.py --model gpt-3x --kernel-order flash,flash_attn_v2,fused,paged --seq 2048 --batch 8 --duration 300
```

Alex Chen: ran 10m on prod-like A100 with kernel-order override, results:
```
tokens/sec median=20.9k  p95=42ms  GPU% 70  cost ~$0.037/M
no-kernel-override (policy) tokens/sec median=10.1k p95=155ms cost ~$0.078/M
```

Alex Chen: looks like selector's p95-threshold policy swaps to paged because p95_flash (120ms) > 150ms? Wait earlier threshold was 150ms — off by margin. Might need adjust to use p90 for selector or incorporate kv-hit-weighting.

Priya Nair: Agreed. Proposal:
- switch policy to use weighted p90 (kv_hit_ratio weighted)
- add short-circuit: if GPU% > 65% prefer flash for throughput
- increase batch_max for flash to 16 for seq>1024

Marco Silva: also check KV cache eviction window — if eviction bursts cause cold tails, decouple tail from kernel selection by using smoothed percentile over 10m.

Rachel (deploy-bot): Canary: kernel-selector-config v2 rolled to 10% at 2026-03-17T10:22Z

Alex Chen: I'll open a small change: selector -> weighted p90 + GPU% bias. Will run canary on non-critical shard.

Lina Gomez: If you want me to run more benches on T4 I can. Might show different crossover point.

Priya Nair: +1. Let's track $/M tokens per kernel in the rollout dashboard (new metric). Add alert if cost delta > 15% for > 30m.

Alex Chen: thanks. I'll post follow-up with canary numbers.
